summary.text: Paul Sherrell is a Republican member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 43, where he has served since November 2016, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In the general election, Sherrell is on the ballot with Samantha Petit.

paragraphs.text: Paul Sherrell was first elected to the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 43 in 2016 and took office on November 8, 2016.
In the 2023–2024 session he was assigned to the Health and Transportation committees.
